dataset_description.title: Bangladeshi Folklore Story Generation & Evaluation Dataset
dataset_description.description: This dataset contains AI-generated folklore stories from various Bangladeshi cultural groups, along with human evaluations and text embeddings for semantic analysis.

linking_keys.description: The combination of (model, culture) serves as the linking key between evaluated_stories.csv and all parquet embedding files. Each parquet file contains the same 599 stories with identical (model, culture) pairs but different embedding representations.

file_relationships.relationship: Each story in evaluated_stories.csv has corresponding embeddings in each parquet file

data_generation_pipeline: 1. Prompts were created for 12 Bangladeshi cultures × 10 story types = 120 unique prompts
2. 5 different LLMs generated stories from these prompts
3. Stories were evaluated by humans on 4 quality dimensions (0-5 scale)
4. Story text was embedded using 5 different embedding models

cultures.includes: Bengali, Chakma, Garo (Mandi), Hajong, Khasi, Manipuri (Meitei), Marma, Mro, Oraon (Kurukh), Rakhine, Santal, Tripura

story_types.includes: Change and Continuity, Community Crisis, Everyday Life Narrative, Human–Nature Relationship, Moral Transgression and Consequence, Origin Story, Rite of Passage, Sacred or Forbidden Space, Trickster or Clever Figure, Wisdom of an Elder

dimensions.name: Cultural Accuracy & Authenticity
dimensions.description: How accurately the story reflects the target culture

dimensions.name: Contextual & Temporal Appropriateness
dimensions.description: Whether the story fits traditional/historical context

dimensions.name: Narrative & Symbolic Coherence
dimensions.description: Story structure and use of cultural symbols

for_analysis: Use evaluated_stories.csv for quality analysis across models and cultures
Join with parquet files on (model, culture, story) for embedding-based analysis
Embedding vectors can be used for clustering, similarity search, or as features
usage_notes.categorical_columns: Columns with <50 unique values are treated as categorical
usage_notes.text_columns: story, prompt, scenario contain long Bengali text suitable for NLP
usage_notes.vector_columns: scenario_embedding and story_embedding contain high-dimensional float vectors
